tasks.goal: Execute input abuse attacks on signup form
dead_ends: A01 empty form showed server error without field highlight
tasks.quote: I broke the form three times and it never told me what I did wrong.

step_log.result: Field truncated silently — no visual feedback

attacks.did: Clicked submit with all fields empty
attacks.actual: Generic error banner at top — no field highlighted
attacks.fix: Add per-field error messages with aria-describedby

attacks.did: Pasted 10000 characters into full name field
attacks.expected: Max length enforcement or visible truncation warning
attacks.actual: Field silently truncated at 255 chars — no feedback
attacks.fix: Add maxlength attribute or show character count

attacks.did: Pasted emoji + RTL override + zero-width spaces
attacks.actual: RTL text broke layout alignment, zero-width chars visible in source
attacks.fix: Normalise Unicode input; apply bidi isolation CSS

attacks.actual: SQL fragment displayed as-is — no injection, but no escaping visible in UI
attacks.fix: No code execution — low risk. Sanitise for safety

attacks.expected: Second click ignored or button disabled
attacks.actual: Two POST requests sent — duplicate charge risk
attacks.fix: Disable submit button on first click; idempotency key on server

blockers.issue: No field-level validation errors on empty submit
